consequence.statement: With socket-based load-balancing, Local Redirect Policies by default redirect traffic that policy-selected node-local backends send to the policy's frontend back to the node-local backends.
consequence.remediation: To keep backends' traffic to the frontend from being redirected, set skipRedirectFromBackend to true on the local redirect policies.

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.16, when Local Redirect Policy is used with socket-based load-balancing, traffic that the policy's own node-local backends send to its frontend is redirected back to the node-local backends by default. Setting spec.skipRedirectFromBackend to true on a CiliumLocalRedirectPolicy turns this off.
